meta.title: Carthage Underfoot
meta.status: Checkpoint 1 — archive credits and descriptions are being verified
meta.honestyNote: Scanned artifacts are real documentation. The low-poly terrain, walls, columns, vegetation, placeholders, and artifact placements are modern abstractions, not archaeological reconstructions.

architectureStudies.title: Great Mosque of Kairouan
architectureStudies.note: A source-based silhouette study of the mosque's quadrilateral enclosure, courtyard, porticoes, and square three-storey minaret. It is not a measured reconstruction.

architectureStudies.title: Capitol of Dougga
architectureStudies.note: A source-based silhouette study of the Capitol's raised sanctuary and six-column front. It is not a measured reconstruction.

architectureStudies.title: Antonine Baths
architectureStudies.note: A source-based diagram of a symmetrical seaside bath complex. It does not reconstruct undocumented walls, roofs, or decoration.
